summary: nVent Electric plc filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026 disclosing an Underwriting Agreement dated September 15, 2026 among the company, nVent Finance S.r.l. and Hoffman Schroff Holdings, Inc., with BofA Securities, Citigroup and J.P. Morgan as representatives. The deal covers $800.0 million aggregate principal of Hoffman Schroff's 6.150% Senior Notes due 2036, fully and unconditionally guaranteed jointly and severally by nVent and nVent Finance, in a registered public offering under an effective Form S-3 shelf. Expected closing September 29, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing, demand and leverage.
